description: The file defines the EducationService class, which provides methods for managing education entities in an HRM system, including CRUD operations and querying functions. It interacts with Data Access Objects (DAOs) to access the data layer.

classes.name: EducationService
classes.description: Service class to handle business logic related to Education entities, including saving, retrieving, listing, counting, deleting, and checking existence of education records.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves a new or existing Education object by delegating to the DAO.

methods.name: getEducationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the EducationDao instance used for database interactions.

methods.name: setEducationDao
methods.description: Allows setting a custom EducationDao instance, useful for dependency injection or testing.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Fetches a list of Education entities matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education entities matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Deletes a list of Education entities identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists in the database, case-insensitive.
